floorPlans.label: Emaar: Elea complete townhouse plans
floorPlans.introduction: Explore Elea’s Slate and Oakley three and four bedroom townhouse layouts. The printed built-up area includes suite, garage and balcony or terrace components; it is not the plot area. Match the style and TH unit code on the full sheet.
floorPlans.note: Complete ground and first floor sheets retain the source’s dimensions, key plans and notices. Areas, layouts, landscaping and furnishings are approximate and may change; confirm the selected plot and sale inclusions.
